pages.text: <name> wandered down a cobblestone street and spotted a tiny bakery with golden smoke curling from its chimney. He peeked inside—and gasped! Muffins floated in the air, cupcakes giggled on their trays, and loaves of bread sang soft lullabies.
“Welcome, <name>!” called a cheerful baker. “This is the Bakery of Wonders, where every treat is baked with joy.”

For days, <name> visited, tasting magical pastries and laughing with cupcakes that played peek-a-boo. But one morning, the bakery looked sad. The muffins drooped, the cupcakes whispered gloomily, and the bread yawned instead of singing.

“Oh no!” said the baker. “The secret ingredient—joy—has been stolen!” <name> noticed a jealous baker hiding behind the counter, clutching a tiny jar labeled ‘Joy’. “We must bring it back,” <name> whispered.

He remembered the baker’s advice: “Joy grows when shared.” <name> invited the townspeople to help. They sang cheerful songs, told funny stories, and danced around the bakery. Then, with a grin, <name> mixed the stolen joy into a big batch of cookies, sprinkling them with laughter and love.

As the treats baked, the bakery shimmered. Muffins floated higher than ever, cupcakes giggled louder, and bread hummed sweet lullabies that filled the street. Even the jealous baker peeked out and smiled, feeling the warmth of happiness again.

The bakery sparkled like morning sunshine. Everyone nibbled magical treats, laughing and sharing. <name> felt proud—he had helped save the bakery with kindness, cheer, and a pinch of love. And from that day on, the Bakery of Wonders never lost its sparkle.
